Komal Singh 
Gurugram, India | +91-9999935893| samakshthakur@yahoo.com | www.linkedin.com/in/komal-singh-a42364b0  
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Solution-Oriented Business Analyst with 10 Years in Capital Markets & Asset Management, Leading Post-Trade Lifecycle, 
Data Governance, and Global Operations Transformation. 
 
EXPERIENCE  
BlackRock – Aladdin Product (Dec 2021 – Present) 
Working as a Business Analyst within the Aladdin product team, responsible for delivering end -to-end solutions across 
the post-trade lifecycle. 
• Supported SWIFT 2025 MT-to-MX (ISO 20022) migration, contributing to 95% adoption and ensuring 
regulatory compliance.  
• Performed end-to-end testing and validation of SWIFT messages using Aladdin, ensuring message 
accuracy and downstream integrity.  
• Led end-to-end analysis and testing of MT566 corporate action messages, including detailed review of 
message structure and data mapping.  
• Managed the post-trade lifecycle covering trade matching, confirmation, settlement, reconciliation, 
and corporate actions.  
• Partnered with engineering, QA, Ops, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and process 
enhancements.  
• Authored and maintained BRDs, FRDs, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria, ensuring clear, 
testable, and traceable requirements.  
• Conducted As-Is / To-Be and gap analysis to identify process inefficiencies and recommend 
improvement opportunities.  
• Executed UAT and regression testing for Equities and cleared IRS trades, validating trade notifications 
and transmissions.  
• Performed deep-dive analysis of raw FpML and SWIFT outputs to verify correctness, isolate defects, 
and support issue resolution.  
• Demonstrated strong expertise in data analysis, Agile methodologies, and the Software Development 
Life Cycle (SDLC).  
• Acted as a bridge between business and IT, aligning stakeholders on requirements and ensuring a 
shared understanding across teams. 
 
BlackRock – Risk Manager (Jul 2018 – Dec 2021)  
Led and developed a team of analysts delivering automated governance, risk, audit, and vendor oversight solutions 
across critical post-trade services using RPA, BI, and robust data governance frameworks.                                                                                                                
• Automated governance and reporting processes using Blue Prism RPA, Power BI improving efficiency and 
accuracy. 
• Supported Risk and Data Governance initiatives including provider governance and due diligence programs. 
• Collaborated with cross -functional stakeholders to identify operational risks through surveys de signed and 
deployed using Qualtrics. 
• Documented business and technical requirements, reviewed SLAs, and monitored operating events to 
ensure compliance. 
• Conducted provider’s internal audit across critical services (Fund Administration, Custody, Transfer Agency, 
Pricing, and Resiliency), assessing the design and operating effectiveness of processes and controls against 
agreed service and risk standards. 
• Supported external audits by reviewing SOC 1 / SOC 2 reports, assessing control effectiveness and 
identifying risk gaps. 
• Analyzed audit findings and partnered with relationship managers to support remediation and audit 
closure. 
• Monitored vendor SLAs, investigated breaches, and supported escalation and governance processes 
across critical post-trade services. 
 
Xoriant Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
Data Management/Regulatory Reporting (May 2016 – Jul 2018) 
• Managed static and reference data supporting global regulatory reporting frameworks ensuring accuracy and 
regulatory compliance. 
• Conducted financial and regulatory research on banks, investment firms, and regulated entities. 
• Tracked and analyzed MiFID II, MIFIR, CCAR, Solvency II, and GDPR regulatory requirements. 
• Maintained LEI, ISIN, SEDOL, and Ticker data for reporting accuracy. 
• Performed data analysis and reporting using SQL, Excel, and Power BI. 
India Infoline Ltd.  
Relationship Executive (Apr 2015 – May 2016) 
Advised clients on equities, derivatives, and mutual funds while executing trades and supporting portfolio management.
